messages:
maria: Heads-up — ran a 1h p95/99 hostside profile on canary `kernel-picker=v2` + `batcher=adaptive`. Seeing ~18% p95 decode latency increase on small-chat workloads after the tokenization shim change. stack: host parse -> tokenizer pool -> writev -> grpc.
liam: Yikes. Is that the release you rolled yesterday?
maria: yeah, rolled at 09:20. Canary was at 10% traffic. baseline p95 was ~45ms, now ~53ms. p99 also shifted ~30ms. Attached logs show lots of `smallwrite` syscall spikes.
devon: Can you paste the flamegraph snippet? suspect token pool contention or extra memcpy in new parse path. Also check KV cache miss rate during those requests.
maria: paste:```
flamegraph snippet (host parse hotpath)
- parse_request 20%
- tokenize_single 30%
  - memcpy input->buf 12%
- writev_dispatch 18%
- grpc_writev_async 10%
```
liam: That memcpy looks suspicious. Did the tokenizer change to return an owned buffer instead of a borrowed slice?
maria: yes. new tokenizer returns Vec<u8> to avoid temp allocs in runtime, but we may be incurring copies when passing to writev.
devon: Also check batching heuristics — adaptive batcher might be sizing smaller batches for short prompts post-change, increasing syscalls. Can you share batching telemetry?
maria: quick stats from 09:30-10:30: `avg_batch_tokens=12`, `avg_batch_size=1.8`, `small_write_count=+42%`, `kvcache_hit=87% -> 84% (slight dip)`
liam: Hmm kvcache dip could be noise but combined with more small writes makes kernel scheduling worse. Could be more context switching.
aaron: Suggests two-step approach: 1) revert tokenizer ownership change to borrow-path on canary for 1h to see delta. 2) experiment with `batcher.min_delay=2ms` to coalesce tiny batches.
maria: I can rollback the tokenizer soon. but can we toggle `min_delay` at runtime?
liam: yes, routing flags allow runtime override per canary hostpool. I can flip for your canary.
devon: Also while you rollback, add a quick `writev` coalescing patch in proxy that aggregates iovecs for contiguous buffers — cheap to try.
aaron: I'll prep the patch, small and guarded behind `coalesce_writev=true`. CI simple unit tests only.
sre-bot: deploybot: Started rollout of config `batcher.min_delay=2ms` to canary (hosts 10%). Track: https://deploys/redwood/1299
maria: flipping min_delay now. re-profiling in 15m.
liam: if p95 drops back to baseline after min_delay, we know batching is the main amplifier.
devon: if not, we'll revert tokenizer and test writev coalesce next. add perf counters for `memcpy` count and `iov_count_per_writev` so we have numbers.
aaron: I'll open a small PR for the coalesce patch + perf counters. tagging @maria for benchmark steps.
maria: thanks. will post updated numbers in this thread. :thumbsup:
